summary.en: Quiet. Latest complete-minute estimated Kp is 1.33; window peak remains 2.33 at 23:11 UTC on 17 September.
summary.zh: 目前為平靜。最新完整分鐘估計 Kp 為 1.33；公開窗峰值仍為 2.33（9 月 17 日 23:11 UTC）。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest complete minute (not a lone new-hour 0.00 placeholder). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window (~358 samples), so earlier hours fall out of the file.

title.en: A magnitude 4.6 earthquake occurred 20 km ESE of Tsunō, Japan on 18 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 18 日，日本 Tsunō 東南偏東約 20 公里發生規模 4.6 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.6, depth about 54 km. Newly listed since the previous hourly update.
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.6，深度約 54 公里。為本輪新上架事件。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
